dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: But we don't really have a say in this, and neither do our customers.

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: Accidents on the job are very common, and we're often delayed by all kinds of things...

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: Sometimes we're several days late, and if we were delivering precious ingredients, they'd be spoiled by then.

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: We don't like to see it happen either, so we can only deliver as quickly as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: But can you pin the blame on our fellow guards?

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: No, you can't! Some jobs require traveling very long distances, across places that may not be safe.
